results.description: A target date that has already passed is flagged

results.preconditions: App running at http://localhost:8501 (started with start_app.bat); stored datasets and saved models present

results.description: A forecast beyond the 30-day reach is refused with a reason
results.preconditions: App running at http://localhost:8501 (started with start_app.bat); stored datasets and saved models present
results.steps: 1. Set the forecast date to 2026-12-25 (46 days after the latest data); 2. Click Generate Forecast
results.expected: No price is produced; a clear message explains the date is beyond reach
results.actual: Message: 'Cannot forecast that date: 2026-12-25 is 46 days after the latest known price (2026-11-09). The forecaster reaches at most 30 days ahead.'; price shown: False
